[RARC.5.8.13] If the integrator's stream callback reports a
recording failure, the consumption loop continues, and the public call that
fired the callback returns the status ([NCBK.1.5]). The tier does not halt: the
stream is an observer, and the engine's behaviour must not depend on whether
its observer succeeded. Whether to keep running on an incomplete recording is
the integrator's decision, taken with the status in hand.
